data.title: Mid-Term Examination Schedule - Fall 2025
data.description: The detailed schedule for the upcoming Mid-Term examinations for all semesters has been released. Please find the attached document for branch-wise details.

data.title: Declaration of Winter Vacation
data.description: This is to inform all students that the college will remain closed for the winter vacation from Dec 24, 2025, to Jan 02, 2026. Classes will resume on Jan 03, 2026.

data.title: Annual Sports Meet 2026 Registration
data.description: Registrations for the Annual Sports Meet are now open. Interested students must submit their names to their respective class teachers by November 20th.

data.title: Library Book Return Deadline
data.description: All students are requested to clear their library dues and return borrowed books before the commencement of the mid-term exams to avoid late fines.

data.title: Inter-School Science Exhibition
data.description: The school is hosting the regional Science Exhibition this Saturday. Students participating must set up their models in the main auditorium by 8:00 AM.

data.title: Transport Fee Revision Update
data.description: Due to changes in fuel prices, the monthly transport fee for Routes 4 through 9 will be revised starting next quarter. Please review the attached notice.

data.title: Parents-Teachers Meeting (Class 10)
data.description: A mandatory PTM for Class 10 students will be held to discuss mid-term performance. Time slots have been assigned in the attached document.
